notes.title: A Little Surprise Awaits! 🎁
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/30394ed0a200fa8d375dec41b3eeda7c37a5526a.png[/img]

[h2][b]A Little Surprise Awaits! 🎁[/b][/h2]

[b]To celebrate the 5th anniversary of Medieval Dynasty, we’re releasing Patch 2.4.1.1, [/b]which includes new content, bug fixes, and balance updates.

We always consider your suggestions, so one of the added features is a possibility to [b]plant berry bushes[/b] in the same way you plant trees.

We’ve also fixed several issues, such as:
[list]
[*] Blocking animal attacks with a shield not working when the player had no tool or weapon in the main hand.
[*] Enabling item stacking causing incorrect item sorting in the inventory.
[/list]
In addition, [b]Intel® XeSS has been updated[/b] to support graphics cards from other vendors.

We’ve also prepared [b]gifts hidden across both maps.[/b] For a limited time, you can find 15 special Gift Baskets on each map, containing random loot—but be careful, not all surprises are pleasant!

For the full list of additions, fixes, and changes, see the [b]update 2.4.1.1 changelog[/b] below:

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Player's ragdoll sounds for wood surfaces
[*] Berry Bushes can now be planted by player
[*] Steam Stats
[*] Gift Baskets
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Blocking animal attacks using shield not working when player didn't have any tool in the main hand
[*] Incorrect crafting animations when interacting with crafting station while crouching
[*] Receiving wool from each animal after skinning if the scissors player had in the hand when starting shearing broke in the process
[*] Duplicating items after dropping them fast from the client's inventory
[*] Not being able to rotate player's character preview in inventory after dragging dye to one of the dye slots
[*] Enabling item stacking causing incorrect item sorting in inventory
[*] When crafting the value in () not displaying the correct amount in inventory
[*] Warning about unsaved changes appearing without making any changes in the graphics settings
[*] Trying to rotate a building in the building mode turning off auto run
[*] Gateways having collisions with themselves on move
[*] Reputation decreasing if bandits saw player picking up stolen items
[*] Dead bandits' ghosts playing combat music after loading save
[*] NPCs collecting items from fields and orchards if the storage was full
[*] Travellers' campfires giving light without burning
[*] Inventory not updating correctly for client in certain cases if player had the talent to recover 50% of resources. Player still received the items, just couldn't see them for some time
[/list]

[b]Updated[/b]
[list]
[*] Killing animals in melee and ranged combat gives the same amount of experience
[*] All animals give more experience when killed
[*] Wolves and bears give more experience for skinning
[*] Skinning dead animals now consumes the lowest quality knife from player's inventory if no knife in hand
[*] Increased loot variety in POIs on both maps
[*] Some "Accident" type POIs were visually updated on Valley Map
[*] Updated Intel® XeSS to support other vendors' graphics cards
[/list]

Kind regards
Render Cube and Toplitz teams

notes.title: 5 Years of Medieval Dynasty ⭐
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/a4b3aa4769a2032cacef5faca5c09102d6bd51a8.png"][/img]
[/p][h2][b]5 Years of Medieval Dynasty ⭐[/b][/h2][p]
[b]Medieval Dynasty is celebrating its 5th anniversary today[/b] and we want to take this chance to thank you for being with us and making this game as it is now!

What once started as a small idea has grown into an amazing project with even better community 💖 And it’s all thanks to you, our players. Your feedback, support, and ideas have guided us from the very beginning, and we couldn’t have come this far without you.

To celebrate, we’ve prepared a special anniversary video. We want us to look back together at how the game has evolved, share some of the challenges we’ve faced, but most of all, Thank you to everyone who has been part of this journey with us.

[/p][previewyoutube="q4VbbuIVI0k;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This anniversary is not only about looking back, it’s also about looking towards the future. We have some exciting announcements we want to share, and it’s a perfect moment to do so 🤩

The past five years have shaped us, and together with you, we’re ready for the next chapter.

Kind regards
Render Cube and Toplitz teams

notes.title: New DLCs And Free Update - Available Now! 🌱
notes.notes:
New DLCs And Free Update - Available Now! 🌱

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/900669231e9d1a8697f36ce5ed6de4cb969eb7a3.png"][/img]

[h2][b]New DLCs And Free Update - Available Now! 🌱[/b][/h2]

We’re excited to finally share all the new features we’ve been working on for the past few months. We couldn’t be more excited for you to experience it 🤩

And what’s more, [b]the main game and Digital Supporter Pack are available at a 40% discount, while new DLCs are 20% off during the Steam Summer Sale![/b] No matter if you’re jumping back in or starting fresh, it’s the perfect time to explore all the new content and see how far your medieval world can grow.

Watch the official trailer to see what's coming to Medieval Dynasty
[previewyoutube=4R7uDhe-Dus;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Plant a Tree Update[/b][/h3]

Medieval Dynasty receives new content with the release of the [b]free Plant a Tree update.[/b] This long-requested update brings two major features: the ability to plant trees, using seedlings gathered while chopping wood, and the option to move freely various constructions with your hammer’s new Move Mode. You also get the improved audio, new UI sounds, and various fixes and updates that enhance the overall experience.[/p][p]For the detailed list of what changes, see the changelog below.

[h3][b]Echoes of Nature DLC[/b][/h3]

Alongside the update, we’re excited to introduce the [b]very first DLC for Medieval Dynasty – Echoes of Nature.[/b] If you’re looking to add more charm and detail to your world, this DLC lets you create beautiful gardens and decorate the alleys and front yards of buildings throughout your village.[/p][p]It adds a wide variety of new outdoor decorations, including trees, shrubs, hedges, stone elements, and more — all designed to blend naturally with your surroundings and respond to the changing seasons. It’s the perfect way to bring more life and beauty to your settlement.

See the list below for the exact list of new features:

[b]🌱 Shrubs[/b]
[list]
[*] Green Shrub
[*] Wild Rose Bush
[*] Yellow Flowering Shrub
[*] White Flowering Shrub
[/list]
[b]🌱 Other Trees[/b]
[list]
[*] Small Evergreen A
[*] Small Evergreen B
[*] Majestic Tree
[/list]
[b]🌱 Rocks[/b]
[list]
[*] Flat Rock
[*] Tall Rock
[*] Wide Rock
[*] Balancing Rock
[/list]
[b]🌱 Ponds[/b]
[list]
[*] Round Pond
[*] Rockery Pond
[/list]
[b]🌱 Fences[/b]
[list]
[*] Low Hedge
[*] Tall Hedge
[/list]
[h3][b]Medieval Dynasty Original Soundtrack Vol. 2[/b][/h3]

[b]Medieval Dynasty Original Soundtrack Vol. 2[/b] is the second DLC created with all the music fans in mind. Now, you are able to access compositions that haven’t been available outside the game. This DLC serves as a complement to the soundtrack previously available with the Digital Supporter Pack.
It features 39 tracks, equalling over 2 hours of immersive music across 3 themed albums:

[list]
[*] Disc 1 – Three Bards Album 
Six cheerful, festive songs performed by the band Three Bards, inspired by troubadour music
[*] Disc 2 – Special Themes Album 
16 tracks that build the game world’s atmosphere – from the main theme to the character creator music, as well as themes for villages and important NPCs
[*] Disc 3 – Gameplay Music Album
17 compositions created for exploration and combat
[/list]
The soundtrack is available for PC platforms (Steam, Epic, GOG), but you can listen to it also using streaming services like Spotify or Apple Music!

[h3][b]Digital Supporter Pack[/b][/h3]

On top of all that, [b]we’re also updating the Digital Supporter Pack[/b] with some fun and fresh content. You’ll get access to a new game save file, perfect for co-op adventures. This save includes several well-known board games reimagined in the world of Medieval Dynasty! Don’t have a die? No worries — we’ve added a special new command to roll one in-game. Full instructions are included in the save file.[

Additionally, we’ve added a set of beautiful new wallpapers showing the stunning natural landscapes of the game. Perfect for the summer season. 
If you already own the Digital Supporter Pack, you can download all the new content for free.

[h3][b]Plant a Tree Update Changelog[/b][/h3]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Possibility to plant Trees/shrubs/bushes. The tree seedlings will grow into full trees after 4 seasons, can be cut and will regrow from stumps after 8 seasons
[*] Intel® XeSS 2 (Super Resolution, Frame Generation, Low Latency) support
[*] ]New hammer mode allowing to move buildings, furnitures, gates, and platforms

Dear Players,
We share with you [b]update 2.3.0.9[/b] which which will resolve some of the problems releated to the recent release:

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Some disconnect issues related to inventory replication if player or storages stored many different items
[*]  Infants despawning instantly for clients if mother was sitting on a mount during birth
[*] The UI input was not updated on the client when switching between rotation and height in the building mode
[*] After loading the game with 0 food/water, the HUD showed the food/water bar as full
[*] Mount inventory state for client not showing correctly in various cases
[/list]
[b]To access the test branch:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right click Medieval Dynasty in your Steam library and pick 'properties'
[*] Then go to 'Betas' on the left side and under Beta participation, select "public_testing"
[*] As soon as you do this Steam should have an update queued for MD and can start downloading the version on the test branch.
[*] If you want to download the live version again (public branch), just change the Beta participation back to "None" like it originally was.
[/list]
As always, this version can contain unexpected bugs. If you are bothered by this, just stay on the live version and wait a couple of days til we roll out the test version.

To be safe, take a backup of your savegame before playing the test version.
You can find your savegame in %LocalAppData%\Medieval_Dynasty\Saved\SaveGames.

Keep in mind that to be able to play co-op, all players must be on the same version. So if you are on the test version, you will not be able to crossplay with other platforms, and all Steam players must download the test version as well.

Kind regards
Render Cube and Toplitz teams

notes.title: Paint Your Town Update - Out Now! 🎨😄
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/653af56dcb97956b618228d4b21667f8d6c04d2d.png[/img]
[h2]Ready to paint your town?🎨😄[/h2]

After decorating your village with crests, we take it one step further and introduce an [b]update 2.3.0.0[/b] that, among other features, allows you to add some colour and patterns to your walls.

But that’s not all!

Other new features include, but are not limited to: 
[list]
[*] the economy tab, 
[*] remote storage, 
[*] “take all” option. 
[/list]
We also fixed problems such as animals leaving their pens. As always, a number of updates were introduced, e.g., item prices now take into account their condition, building costs are now visible in the crafting menu, and more.

Read the complete [b]update 2.3.0.0 changelog[/b] and see everything it adds, fixes, and updates:

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Remote Storages - A player can use resources from remote storages when crafting/building while within their range. The maximum range increases with the level of the storage. This also works for a chest in the building where the player is crafting. 
[*] Economy summary tab - contains data from different time periods on items created and consumed in the village
[*] Painting the walls of buildings with colours and patterns
[*] House presets with sticks / logs / stones
[*] Item stacks with different conditions
[*] Option to take all items from containers and bandit corpses
[*] Memorial Stone on the Oxbow map
[*] New hit and swipe sounds for battle axe
[*] Sounds of hitting snow, fabric, armour with: iron axe, stone axe, fists, iron hammer
[*] New footsteps sounds for NPCs and players - metal armour
[*] Season switch sounds (different sounds for each season)
[*] Projectiles spawning particles when breaking
[/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Husbandry animals leaving their pens
[*] The map opening with the player marker in the centre
[*] Centering on a player on a map
[*] Inability to turn in side quests to Derwan during main story while on a horse
[*] Broken vase given as a quest reward
[*] Wrong bucket counting for event restrictions
[*] Fixed reward for quest Flowertelling
[*] Fixed weight of simple torch 
[*] Events not taking storages into account
[*] Some events
[*] Head shape of a player resetting after loading the game
[*] Character's ears sticking closely to the head even if the helmet's visibility is turned off
[*] Wrong character hair variant if a barber was visited while wearing a helmet with turned off visibility
[*] Melee weapons not having any reverb inside buildings and caves
[*] Range weapons getting stuck preventing bandits from shooting
[*] 
[/list]
[b]Updated[/b]
[list]
[*] Player can hide unavailable items in People's Demand Control tab in Management
[*] Buildings costs are now visible in crafting menu
[*] Item prices now take into account their condition
[*] The total animal feed demand is now visible in the building details
[*] Number of dye slots is now visible in the item description
[*] Less poison reduction: Cherry Wine
[*] Higher productivity: Bucket with Milk
[*] Changed technology gain from crafting most items
[*] Changed experience gain from crafting most items
[*] Changed availability from Vendors: Knives, Sickles, Scythes, Scissors, Shovels, Hand Lantern, Pouches, Backpacks, Saddlebags, Spears, Bows, Crossbows
[*] Reduced temperature of the hottest summer weather
[*] Women with infants go for a walk outside their house
[*] Building walls colorations for story villages 
[*] Mixed special audio effects: stagger and block break
[*] New sounds of sword hitting snow
[*] Slight network optimizations for Fields and Orchards
[*] Reduced memory usage when a great number of NPCs is present
[*] Tweaked projectile hit effects
[*] All Languages updated
[*] Skill Handyman has been removed. From now on, everyone can insulate their homes.
[*] Instead of the Handyman skill, there will be a Full Focus skill which removes stamina consumption from Inspector Mode
[/list]
Kind regards
Render Cube and Toplitz teams

notes.title: The Honker: Mystery Uncovered 💀
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/fda46339d82d93b97ef928e6cf47f4f3707f8c9a.png[/img]
[h2]The Honker: Mystery Uncovered 💀[/h2]

This Halloween, uncover the chilling tale of [b]Pike Lake’s darkest secret[/b]—the story behind the Honker, a black-feathered creature with blazing red eyes that haunts the lake to this day... 😱💀

Once, there was a hunter named Oswin, known for his pride and fearlessness. One autumn, when rumours spread of a black-feathered goose with blazing red eyes haunting Pike Lake, Oswin swore to claim it as his prize 🏆

Ignoring all warnings, he set off at dawn, tracking the creature’s eerie honks through the mist. By the water’s edge, he finally saw it—a giant black goose, watching him with eyes like molten rubies. As he aimed his bow, a chilling voice filled his mind: [b]“Those who seek what is forbidden shall pay the price.”[/b]

Oswin laughed and threw his bow. But as it struck, his laughter turned to screams as his head transformed into that of a monstrous red-eyed black goose!

Days later, villagers found him roaming the woods, his body still human but his head that of a goose, honking wildly, driven mad by the curse 😵

To this day, travellers at Pike Lake swear they hear his mad honking, warning all who dare disturb the dark waters...

Kind regards

notes.title: Crossplay Contest Winners 🌟
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/919a00f7d022a6e734097245f1e61dade0d6279e.png[/img]
[h2]Villagers! 📣[/h2]

We have exciting news for you. After thorough consideration of your team-building suggestions, the scholars have chosen the best answers, and now it’s time to announce who the winners are.

Starting with great ideas that we decided to award with a Steam key to Medieval Dynasty:
[list]
[*][b]Rozer927[/b]
Depends on which goals you all have, you all gave to he definitely on the same page have the same interests and have desire to always thrive for the best for the team and always willing to learn and become better and stronger.
[*] [b]Dylan P.[/b]
By finding a common vision and passion, creating a bond of trust and environment where no one is afraid to speak up or express disapproval to any aspect of the product. Leaders guide, teach and adapt, Dictators control, command and are unwilling to change.
[*] [b]Amér K.[/b]
Creating a team is easy, but creating a good team is hard. You need to find like-minded people, people with the same interests, hobbies, sports, etc. If you have nothing to talk about other than the game, you will quickly find the experience getting more and more dull over time. Co-op is best experienced with people you enjoy talking to.
[*] [b]Cameron H.[/b]
The best way to create a team is to have a simple, core ethos. Something that should be put before all other things. Is it to be dedicated to an individual task, maximise independence of team members, or something to ensure everybody is like-minded. This allows anybody to know how much they're interested, and what they may be willing to compromise for being part of the team.
[*] [b]Daniel P.[/b]
When creating a team, it's important to have a sense of dynamics in a crew. People should be happy to try a bit of everything, and want to branch out and try new things and roles. But also have the chance to be in a safe space where they can also just do what they love. For example, in my crew, we have a mixed bag of payers / people. Some of us are on PC, some are on console, and we struggle to find games to play and enjoy ourselves and the other's company. This game has that chance! Our team is a mix of traits, such as hunters, gatherers builders, artsy-decor-crafters, and gathers. Some of us has a sense of PVP / PVE nature as well, so it's our job to be the ones who protect the crew in times of need. We also tend to work together a lot on projects, bringing us together with our own set of skills to make example the settlement come alive or as "natural" as possible. With a mixed bag of players with unique skills, we work as a team in most games and have fun along the way. Now with this update, we have gathered more friends whom been super excited to join us in the world of Medieval Dynasty. We will both guide them and let them explore and learn this amazing game. We are a smaller group of gamers, but we take care of one another with great care, both in-game and outside of gaming. Gaming Unites as many other forms of entertainment can, and this is one of the many games we hope to share stories around when we are older and hang-out in real life, to look back at fondly and gave us good laughs and memories about.
[/list]
And the best of the best: 

[b]Noah F.[/b]
Lo, noble seeker of knowledge and wisdom, attend to these words with care, for herein lies the ancient lore on the finding of the perfect company of comrades, fit for any quest or noble endeavour. First, seek ye those of stout heart and steadfast spirit. Forsooth, bravery and constancy are the bedrock upon which all great deeds are founded. In times of peril and shadow, 'tis the resolute heart that shall not falter nor flee. Next, gather ye men and women of diverse skills and talents. Just as the sword complements the shield, so too must the strengths of one balance the weaknesses of another. The wise scribe, the cunning scout, the valiant knight, and the healing maiden—each hath a part to play, each a thread in the tapestry of success. Moreover, look to the character of thy companions. Trustworthiness and loyalty are virtues beyond measure. A team divided by deceit and mistrust shall crumble before the first gale of adversity. But those bound by honour and fidelity shall stand as an unyielding bulwark. Furthermore, seek ye those who possess a keen mind and quick wit. For many are the challenges that cannot be overcome by brawn alone. The cunning stratagem and the clever ruse oft win the day when sheer force doth fail. Thus, let thy fellowship include those who think as well as those who fight. In addition, nurture camaraderie and fellowship amongst thy band. A team united in purpose and spirit shall achieve greatness beyond the sum of its parts. Through shared trials and triumphs, let bonds of friendship be forged, stronger than the finest steel. Lastly, remember always to heed the counsel of those wiser than thyself. Even the greatest of leaders benefit from the wisdom of others. Be humble in thy command, and open to the insights of thy fellows. Thus, noble seeker, by following these precepts, thou shalt gather unto thyself a team most perfect and true, ready to face the challenges of the world and to achieve deeds of valour and renown. Go forth with courage and wisdom, and may the favour of the heavens shine upon thee and thy companions. There is no better occasion than the crossplay update premiere!!!

notes.title: What is going on with the update?
notes.notes:
[h2][b]What is going on with the update?[/b][/h2]

We are asked this question daily in emails, direct messages, and comments, so we want to answer you all in this post.

[b]The update is coming[/b], and it is coming soon.

We work hard every day to provide enjoyable gameplay for players across every platform. It makes us sad to hear that some of our players feel abandoned or forgotten. Our primary concern for the past few months has been to prepare the update for console players, and not only them.

We understand the frustration, as we are equally excited about the release as our community is, but we also acknowledge that the lack of official communication from our side has caused more doubt around the update, and we want to apologise for that.

Very soon we will reveal more specific information about the update which not only will bring awaited co-op mode for consoles but also many surprises for the rest of our amazing players. We are working on the next step marked on our roadmap and we are looking forward to moving further to the new content which will enrich the gameplay.

notes.notes:
[h3]Changelog - Patch 2.0.2.1[/h3]

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New parameter in the User Interface settings - Dynamic Inventory Avatar
[*] Added arrows to the category icons in the radial menu for crafting items

[list]
[*] Inhabitants consume items containing water too slowly

[*] In some cases NPCs that left/were thrown out of the village may still be visible in client's management
[*] If confirm input is held in building's details while on other tab than overview or setting up production then it will open details of last selected NPC/Animal even though input is not shown at the bottom
[*] Giving custom names to animals, buildings and fields doesn't work if done by a client
[*] Client sometimes becoming stuck on initialization if he has high latency and packet losses
[*] Well sometimes becoming uninteractable due to empty reference when ending crafting animation

[*] Growing chickens are always brown
[*] Character creator appearing when dismounting on valley map

[*] Transfering items as a client to mount through inventory doesn't update weight correctly
[*] Assigning apprentice to workplace doesn't update management tab
[*] Problems when building roads using gamepad
[*] Clients getting launched at high speed when entering ragdoll state in some cases
[*] No snow on one of the hay piles
[*] Sometimes an NPC may get stuck in stairs, logs, village decorations, etc.
[*] Some bandits' issues
[*] Unstuck and map border now reset player velocity to remove potential issues with player moving too quickly and continuing to move even after teleport
[*] Players thrown outside of the map now will get teleported to the center of it
[*] Boys have their eyes open while sleeping
[*] Bandits have hair breaking through the hood under certain conditions
[/list]
[h3][b]Updated[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Keys forbidden to use during keybinding (num lock, scroll lock, windows key, menu key, F5 and F9)

[*] Tweaked player characters ragdoll synchronization

notes.title: Patch 2.0.1.8 on the Public Branch
notes.notes:
[h3]Changelog - Patch 2.0.1.8[/h3]

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Weight values with overload color to the trade windows
[*] New anti-aliasing - Temporal Anti-Aliasing Upsampling (TAAU)
[*] Possibility to select the anti-aliasing method in the game options (Off, FXAA, TAA, TAAU)
[*] Current coins value for buyer and seller in transfer window
[*] Visibility of npc's age and mood in inspector mode
[*] Players can deal shock damage and knock others down
[*] New parameter in the graphics settings - Point Light Shadows
[*] Sounds for "NPC Idle Lean on Railing" animations
[/list]

[h3][b]Fixed[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Dismounting animations not working in some cases
[*] Bandits ragdoll not activating
[*] Case where NPCs would slide across the ground after ending dialogue
[*] Non-buildable areas at the foot of the big waterfall - either made buildable or clearly blocked by rocks
[*] Inhabitants consume items containing water contrary to the order displayed
[*] If player completes quest while on horse then the player may not recieve technology points for that quest
[*] On loading the saved game player will once be again assigned to parents (if they are still alive) which results in living in two homes at once
[*] Case where client could get stuck in the dialogue if he had high latency and was starting and ending dialogue with npc rapidly
[*] Wrong sound in one of the rivers
[*] Reduced likelihood of client falling through the ground when entering ragdoll state
[/list]

[h3][b]Updated[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed prices for pouches and backpacks
[*] Adult pigs eat less (1,251 animal food per day)
[*] Changed productivity of mine
[*] Sounds for Cave particles (falling rocks and water dropplets)
[*] Polish language
[*] Visual improvements to windows for crafting, dropping, transferring, buying and selling items
[*] Fog tweaks
[*] Raw mushrooms are more poisonous
[*] Quark and Egg provide less food
[*] Raw fishes effects changed
[*] Milk and Soured milk provide less water
[*] Salty sticks effect is weaker
[*] Salty Pretzel effect last shorter
[*] System for detecting additional npc's information in inspector mode
[*] Freshness now decreases in chests slower to match decomposition rate of food storage
[*] Characters ragdoll - synchronization, smoother transitions, influence of hit force, tweaks
[/list]


Kind Regards,
Render Cube and Toplitz Teams

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129580/Medieval_Dynasty

notes.title: Patch 2.0.1.5 on the Public Branch
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog - Patch 2.0.1.5[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/a866fb9e23cc84af711f15ab3c4c030f08a733d0.gif[/img]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Added ability to drop a stack of items by holding down the drop button
[*] A visual indicator to show the player that data is being loaded
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Firewood requirements do not update with building improvements
[*] Dialogues sometimes getting stuck on an empty window for the client if they have high latency
[*] Wrong display of skill descriptions in Spanish
[*] Client can flirt indefinitely as long as the player picks the right answers
[*] Client can give only one gift per game
[*] Client can give a gift after every game reload
[*] If host and client flirt with the same NPC and on another day host talks first with the given NPC then client isn’t able to flirt 
[*] Changing torch type while torch is lit doesn't change the torch in player’s hands 
[*] A new torch in inventory gets the hp of an old torch
[*] Infinite torches if player drops the one equipped or transfers it to a chest
[*] Picking one torch, then picking another from a stack then dropping the first and lighting the second one resulted in wrong item getting its condition dropped
[*] Client's torch can be indestructible when they pick another torch and throw away the old one 
[*] Weight of the player is not correctly updated when client transfers/sells/buys item
[*] In peoples' needs, the items were wrongly counted 
[*] If a client upgrades a building to a higher level, then the game tries to recover building materials and give them to the host instead of the player making the upgrade
[*] Client can manage only items from the first buildings (for example, only items from Hunting Lodge I when managing Hunting Lodge II) 
[*] After giving a gift as client, NPC always responds as if no gift was given
[*] On loading the game, player always equips first one of the equipped item type from the inventory instead of the correct one
[*] After torch burning out for client, the new automatically equipped one doesn't show its usage in HUD 
[*] Single player cave near Branica - two cave deposits moved to be reachable by the player.
[/list]
[b]Updated[/b]
[list]
[*] Generic NPCs on the Oxbow map will now have rumours option in their dialogues
[*] The effect of holding buttons has been sped up and smoothed out (in sliders and list of buttons)
[*] The input for transferring items to a mount has been changed 
[*] Cherry Pie has a lower stamina boost
[*] Fruit Tart has a lower water boost
[*] Flatbread and Flatbread with Onion provide less food
[*] Oat Rolls, Rye Bread, Wheat Bread, Wheat Rolls, White Bread provide less food
[*] Oat Rolls, Wheat Bread, Wheat Rolls effects last shorter
[*] White Bread effect is weaker
[*] Potion of Sobriety completely frees you from the consequences of drunkenness
[*] Soured Milk has a longer effect, better alcohol reduction and provides more water
[*] Pickaxe has a +5 damage per hit
[*] Regular summer day has a colder afternoon
[*] More visual details and decorations in caves, both on co-op and single maps
[*] Tweaked character rag doll
[*] Some river and lake banks are updated with foliage
[*] Polish language is updated
[/list]

Kind Regards,
Render Cube and Toplitz Teams

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129580/Medieval_Dynasty

notes.title: Patch 2.0.1.3 on the Public Branch
notes.notes:
[h3]Changelog - Patch 2.0.1.3[/h3]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] On the Valley map new game customization for fast building and crafting starts working only after reload or reapplying
[*] Tweaked mount ragdoll [i](Work in progress)[/i]
[*] Missing material references for stairs in some cases
[*] Potential crash in foliage replication system
[*] Workbench interaction not starting and ending properly for brewing station, cauldron, millstone and grate which resulted in workbench being unusable after first use
[*] Workbenches sometimes appearing interactable even if player is currently occupying it
[*] Missing one dialogue text during first conversation with Sedowin
[*] Not being able to use ESC to exit some basic dialogues.
[*] NPC consume the durability of scythes and sickles at the same rate as the player.
[*] Dragging and dropping items to armor slots (clothes, torch, arrow) may sometimes not work correctly
[*] Two cases of possible null references for NPCs and Stats if player has big latency
[*] Dying during using the notice board doesn't remove notice board UI
[*] Temperature tolerance is sometimes not correctly displayed in inventory
[*] Various fixes for Goat and Cow milking interaction if player has big latency
[/list]

[b]Updated[/b]
[list]
[*] Characters begin to feel the effects of Overheat at 30 Celsius degrees.
[*] Straw Hats has better heat protection
[*] Basic Summer weather has colder high noon
[*] Trousers with cuffs stats and recipe changed
[*] Pants prices changed
[*] Loading optimizations
[*] Login logic for EOS
[*] Wisent drop less meat
[*] Porridge provide lower Stamina bonus
[*] Porridge with apple, Soup, Scrambled Eggs and Scrambled Eggs with mushrooms provide less food
[*] Porridge with berries provide less food and has lower Stamina bonus but has longer duration time
[*] Vegetable Soup provide less food and water consumption multiplayer
[*] Mushroom Soup provide lower temperature protection
[*] Various code optimizations and clean up
[*] "Chapters" are no longer in the journal on the oxbow map
[*] Stats protection now also works during using the notice board
[*] French updated
[/list]


Kind Regards,
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44741218]Render Cube[/url] and Toplitz Teams

notes.title: Patch 2.0.0.7 on the Public Branch
notes.notes:
[h2]Changelog - Patch 2.0.0.7[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/54f123fda31b48de88fbfe7066104fd00f6d9ae9.gif[/img]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*]New footsteps sounds for player, npc and all animals - deep water walking 
[*]Sounds for a few NPC's animations
[*]Quickload on solo oxbow
[*]Epic Online Service logging window to some multiplayer related menus
[/list]


[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Some cases when player character would get overwritten with another player character
[*]An error that could cause desync problems between clients and host when it comes to plant state
[*]Sometimes the air temperature has incorrect values
[*]In some cases "Grab" interaction showed up when items were not picakable
[*]Player's husband/wife can speak texts belonging to unmarried NPCs (chatters)
[*]Player's wife (NPC from quest) doesn't recognize him as her husband (incorrect dialogue) [SINGLE PLAYER]
[*]When child grows from infant to toddler, a ghost infant stays floating above the child's bed
[*]Clients sometimes unable to interact with beds
[*]Clients unable to lay down in the bed if their partner is sleeping in it
[*]Players unable to lay down in the same bed if they have partners
[*]Player able to sometimes interact with beds when its already occupied
[*]Player sometimes having a "Free Up Workbench" prompt on the bed if there is an npc sleeping in it
[*]Some fields not being interactable if they were placed on a really high or really low elevation
[*]Host can assign clients' partners when they are not in the session which after some time may result in that partner marrying NPC and having double marriage
[*]After loading game animals settings revert always to 100% and ommits customization. Only starts working after one season
[*]On coop in the Oxbow leaving some UIs with gamepad makes character jump
[*]After loading the game clients may not be able to complete more than one objective from quest that is in progress 
[*]Overlapping panels in new game menu
[*]Removed context menu after clicking RMB on session code
[*]Dialogue getting stuck after asking Stoislawa to move aside
[*]Wrong dialogue text after trading with Niemila
[*]Swir in some cases might have not spawned for quest [i](Loading or reloading save file will bring him back)[/i]
[/list]


[b]Updated[/b]
[list]
[*]The development stage achievements now give every previous one as well if they were not already unlocked
[*]Icons of vendors in Piastiovia
[*]Basic summer weather has warmer afternoon

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty co-op available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/d751da8264f04307d38a44bad5939acb723a7ba3.png[/img]

Hello, Village Elders!

[h2]The big day has arrived! [/h2]

Today, the gates to the [b]Oxbow[/b] finally open, and you can explore the new land 🗺️ 

Experience new adventures in the Oxbow, discover beautiful and exciting new places and build your own settlement in this wonderful neighbourhood. Set off solo or with your friends, and don't forget to personalize your appearance in the character creator.

[b]The Oxbow launches on Steam today, 7 December 2023. [/b] The version for the PS5, Xbox Series X/S and other PC platforms will be released in Q1/Q2 of 2024. The update includes the Co-Op mode for up to 4 players, and several other features like the aforementioned new map, character creator and a playable female character.

[previewyoutube=IQa0DPPBtYM;full][/previewyoutube]

In the near future, we will continue to improve our game to give you the best possible experience. However, as we reached the Co-Op Mode Update launch on Steam, it's a great moment to look ahead and update our Road Map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/43cd3a953745cc649b32c9e939e00f7c16b0c9c4.png[/img]

🎮 Our next goal is to launch the Co-Op Mode Update on PS5, Xbox Series X/S and other PC platforms in Q1/Q2 of 2024. 

🛡️ Then we will fire up our forges for the Armours, Crests, Shields, and More Update which is coming next year.

🤐 But that’s not all! We will have another surprise coming for you, but more on that later. 😉

notes.title: Message to content creators - Copyright Claim Issue
notes.notes:
Dear content creators,

First of all, many thanks for your continued support for our game “Medieval Dynasty”!

Unfortunately, it has come to our attention that when streaming “Medieval Dynasty” in recent days, some of you have encountered problems with monetising your works due to claims of alleged copyright infringement. We believe the reason behind this is that our game is currently being targeted by a so-called copyright troll. Such people or entities bring unfounded claims against others based on copyright that they do not in fact own – in this case copyright to the game’s soundtrack. Their goal is of course to try and monetise others’ content for themselves.

Elina Ungarova, our great artist who created the music, as well as the development team from Render Cube, and we from Toplitz, are all outraged by this situation.

Our legal team is working with highest priority to resolve this situation so that you can once again stream and upload videos of the game without any worries, including the music.

In the meanwhile, if you have been impacted by this, please reach out to us via email to: influencer@toplitz-productions.com. Please let us know when you were blocked from receiving money and on which platform this happened. 

We will provide you with an appropriate template that you can send to the platform holder (e.g., YouTube, twitch) to dispute such wrongful claims and ask for the demonetisation to be removed.

The more cases we can present, the sooner we can expect results.

So, let us fight this copyright troll together!

Many thanks & all the best from 
Elina, Render Cube and Toplitz

New is the photo mode!

In a nutshell, you must be in the 3PV, then you can call up the photo mode. Here you can make settings just like on a camera. Rotate the camera, adjust the lens, brightness, saturation (black and white images!), exposure or colour effects. Have fun experimenting.

The teams of Render Cube and Toplitz Productions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/744d79478708ecb2f086e33792b44550b26cd80e.png[/img]

Hello Village Elders!

Another update bringing various fixes and updates to the game. Check out the list of changes and updates below!

Talk to you soon again!

The teams from Render Cube and Toplitz Productions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ad5a520ff892afe53d94d369ed41191b6caac6ef.png[/img] [list]
[*] Ability to enable DirectX12 if supported (Performance increase dependent on hardware).
[*] Ability to continue placing furniture and gates without reselecting them in the construction menu.
[*] Play In Background option to sound settings.
[*] New sounds for Candles, Chandeliers and Lanterns.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ce731c2491c0f2391442fc4636b5f8dca5f13368.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Strange behaviour of the player's character after completing the quest ‘Dirty Deed’ while riding a horse.
[*] Strange behaviour of the player's character after switching to the heir while riding a horse.
[*] Buildings can't be upgraded when the building limit is reached.
[*] Issue when an NPC gets stuck between buildings and can't go to work.
[*] Sometimes the heir is still trapped in the quest dialogue after the quest fails.
[*] Weapon holstering when cancelling building on alternative 2 on gamepad.
[*] Ability to jump while player was ending the crafting animation.
[*] Player getting stretched when drunk on a horse.
[*] Players right hand was open when crouching and holding a hammer while moving or being idle.
[*] Broken lynx model when the animal is running some distance from the player.
[*] NPCs sometimes don't use bridges and walk in the water next to the bridge.
[*] Getting or losing zero reputation shows a notification.
[*] In field management selecting the ‘Clear’ option results in a wrong icon.
[*] Season settings for Roland’s clothing.
[*] Some NPCs do not have dialogues about not having a home.
[*] Longer load time for the season change with large number of orchards.
[*] After the skip of the day / season, some chickens stop sleeping on their roosts and sleep on the floor.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/38afb1f8ffa8671aa495fac9087cbf3fd967f259.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Inventory and memory usage optimizations.
[*] Night lighting improvements for low and medium shadow settings.
[*] Moose enlarged.
[*] Reworked the way achievements are handed out (lowering the possibility of not getting an achievement when the player should get it).
[*] Player can now turn on autorun during movement.
[*] Smoother camera transition when crouching and stopping crouching.
[*] The ‘Repeat’ interaction now only works for gathering animal remains from traps.
[*] Waggoner now has sounds for greetings and goodbyes.
[*] Numerous UI improvements.
[*] Enlarged texts in circular menus.
[*] Enlarged descriptions in the game configuration menu.
[*] Enlarged UI elements in the item transfer window.
[*] Picking items with both hands full should now take the same amount of time as with one free hand.
[*] Mixed ambient sounds (winds and rains).
[*] Improvement of fist punching sounds on different surface - sounds of punching are now firmer.
[*] Improvement of attenuation effects on sounds (3D audio effects) for: Torches, Deer.
[*] Sounds reverb effects depend on distance from the player to animals sounds.
[*] Mixed some SFX sounds.
[*] Numerous tweaks and improvements to the terrain.
[*] Description of quest will now scroll automatically if required on a gamepad.
[*] Hide/Unhide HUD with gamepad now can only be done via game menu.
[*] Notifications are now totalled if text is the same.
[*] Tweaked physical materials.
[*] All languages updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Fall Update!
notes.notes:
Hello village elders!

Brand new from the Public Stage comes our Fall Update for you! It contains many improvements and fixes and some new features. Have a look at the notes below to see what has changed.

But as the saying goes, before the update is after the update, and that's why we'll be diligently pursuing two more major updates planned on the roadmap.

What we are also looking forward to on this very day: Medieval Dynasty is also coming out on console today! Tell your console friends about it! Or gift them a copy for the next festive occasion! 😉

We hope you enjoy playing and we'll definitely catch up with you soon!

The teams of Render Cube and Toplitz Productions


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ad5a520ff892afe53d94d369ed41191b6caac6ef.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Sounds of eating bread and soup.
[*] Trees can now deal damage when falling - friendly NPCs are safe.
[*] If the player falls from a certain height or gets hit by a tree he will get knocked out - if not, the fallen player will get up after 5 seconds.
[*] Player can get knocked down from a mount if hit by a falling tree or if the mount dies with player on
[*] Physics blending when the player is drunk above and beyond 80%.
[*] Player can now trip over and fall while drunk above and beyond 80%.
[*] Children improve their skills when changing into a toddler, child, or teenager.
[*] When holding the interaction button this interaction is going into a loop now, as if player was clicking constantly.
[*] Quick save button in game menu.
[*] A lot of new ambient sounds for day and night birds. There are 40 different bird species, divided into meadow / forest biomes, seasons (there are different birds in winter) and hours (birds sing more in the morning and evening).
[*] Ambient sounds for cave: music ambient, water drops, and rocks drops. 
[*] Smooth transitions of attenuation of environmental sounds like winds, rains or birds depending on the type or levels of building / cave / or being underwater.
[*] Reverb of sounds depends on the type or levels of buildings.
[*] Sounds of insects. There are 8 different insect species, divided into day / night and meadow / forest biomes.
[*] New all sounds for moose.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ce731c2491c0f2391442fc4636b5f8dca5f13368.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] A rare possible crash occurring during the economy update.
[*] Sometimes the bandits for the "I'm Vengeance" quest were not spawned. Affected saves should be fixed with this update.
[*] "Wanted: One-legged, Ankle-Length, Wear Caps" quest can happen in summer and can't be completed.
[*] The "The Master Angler" quest gives away too many coins.
[*] The "Great Expectations of a Young Builder" quest has bugged text for a single goal.
[*] The camera shakes when increasing building levels.
[*] No highlighting of modules during Market Stall destruction.
[*] Bandits sitting while in combat.
[*] Bandits notifying others about player.
[*] When the game was saved at 6 pm, the NPCs didn't finish their work after loading.
[*] Position and behavior of Kestrel after loading a saved game.
[*] Special NPC stands near Denica for many years if the player hasn't invited him to his village ("Lost" quest).
[*] Player's wife stands somewhere and does nothing.
[*] Possibility to get stuck at season skip when starting a trade at a certain moment.
[*] Being able to open sleep context menu for campfires inside of buildings.
[*] Predators not engaging player when attacked while chasing a prey.
[*] In specific situations generic quests can block getting special side quests.
[*] In some cases, quests can take away equipped items that are required for it.
[*] Animals not engaging player when attacked.
[*] In some cases, predators ignore player.
[*] Bandits can turn their heads too far.
[*] Characters not looking down properly.
[*] Animal traps don't activate properly.
[*] Abnormal NPC behavior after rapidly starting and ending a conversation.
[*] Special NPC from the "Mother of Inventions" quest sometimes appears in the roof of the building.
[*] The player should less likely being able to interact with stones or trees when picking up items.
[*] Player character still covered in dirt after season skip.
[*] Player being able to start dialog while NPC wakes up.
[*] Incorrect display of heat and cold protection in clothes schemes in the technology window.
[*] Incorrect condition values for building modules in the management list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/38afb1f8ffa8671aa495fac9087cbf3fd967f259.png[/img]

[*] Finding the target bandit camp now persists throughout the "I'm Vengeance" quest to easily locate the bandit camp if player runs away from it.
[*] Bandit combat behavior.
[*] Movement speed reduction on steep terrain for characters and animals.
[*] Horse and donkey animations while in water.
[*] Bandits dodge behavior.
[*] Bandits pathfinding when chasing.
[*] Increased font size in some UI elements (quest descriptions, objectives, rewards, knowledge, quick slot).
[*] Animation blending for various tools in third person.
[*] Animation for special NPC from "Mother of Inventions" quest.
[*] Optimized and smoothed characters rotation
[*] Positions of HUD elements
[*] Ammo is now visible in HUD in the same way as building hammer mode or chosen seed for bag
[*] Dynasty Reputation now lowers when hitting animals from other villages instead of only on kill
[*] Player character IK
[*] Rendering optimisations.
[*] Bandits are less likely to notice crouching player.
[*] Tweaked campfire shadows and lighting.
[*] Screen effect of poisoning.
[*] Animation and behaviour of some quest NPCs.
[*] Increase Dynasty Reputation if player kills bandit.
[*] Trees are now more likely to fall in the opposite direction of player.
[*] Improved mount feet placement on slopes and small obstacles.
[*] The pinpoint in management map is now more accurate.
[*] On loading a save file now if any quest item persists in the inventory that shouldn't no longer be there then the system will remove this item.
[*] Workshop workers are sometimes unable to enter the building.
[*] Optimized animals.
[*] Optimized NPCs.
[*] Numerous tweaks and improvements to the terrain.
[*] Smoothed out NPC and animal rotation.
[*] The player suffers less damage from falling a greater distance than before.
[*] Tweaked fall damage.
[*] Larger character parameter icons and texts in the inventory.
[*] Larger icons in the map legend.
[*] More schemes are visible in the technology window.
[*] Increased readability of bright text in the HUD.
[*] HUD is now hidden in the game menu.
[*] Decreased schemes' prices for juices.
[*] Increased schemes' prices for vases with flowers.
[*] Reduced stamina consumption in inspector mode.
[*] Animation for the heir in Heir Quests.
[*] Skill setting for a newborn.
[*] Blending from jumping to crouching in place.
[*] Projectiles will now always attach to dead animal.
[*] Optimized animals.
[*] Increased readability of selected text in dialogues.
[*] Bandit movement.
[*] When interacting with chests in storages, a selected item’s detail will hint by color if it's the correct storage for that item.
[*] Chinese font
[*] Ukrainian font
[*] Russian font
[*] All languages updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Son, you got a lot to tell! – The Heir Update
notes.notes:
Hello Village Elders!

The time has come! You hold in your hands: the Heir Update. 

Remember in the game? You have a house; you look at it and then ask if you could still extend it. 

We felt the same way, so we took the tools in our hands. We figuratively sawed, filed, sanded and, hammered - and the game got bigger and bigger.

Before the Heir update, Medieval Dynasty had about 75,000 words of text. That's roughly the equivalent of a 250-page book. Now we're close to 120,000 words of text. It took a while to manoeuvre this huge update into the valley, but it's finally here!

[previewyoutube=_xvRuV1X7CI;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think about the update! Tell us about your heir! As always, feel free to post below in the comments or on our social media channels.

Have fun playing and talk soon!


The teams of Render Cube and Toplitz Productions



[b]PS: Some languages are still work in progress and will be updated later![/b]

notes.title: Update to v.1.4.0.2. - PUBLIC STAGE – UPDATED!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Something happened in our Medieval Dynasty laboratory, we created monsters... text monsters. The Heir update is huge. No, it's massive. It took a while to usher them all down the narrow hamlets and paths to the village, but they're finally here!

Dear village elders, grab one of the exemplars (it just wants to play!) and find out what the heirs have to offer.

Currently the Public Stage is only available in English. However, all translations are currently in the works, and should be available for you soon.

Have fun with the Heirs update on the Public Stage.

[h3] How to join the public staging? [/h3]
Some of you probably have not done this before, so here is a small guide:

[b] Prerequisite: [/b]
You must have Medieval Dynasty in your library – obviously.

[b]The procedure[/b]
[list]
[*] Open your game library.
[*] Right Click on Medieval Dynasty there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/8bc173d815d0b0d381841d13445c3de1d40b42b6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/248a195d609cae5f11facbaedcc7418ebb41af1b.jpg[/img]

[*] Select the tab "BETAS".*
[*] Enter this password below the dropdown in the field:
MedievalStaging
[/list]

[list]
[*] Press CHECK CODE
[*] Use the drop down and select “release_build_staging”. This is the public stage.
[*] Press Close
[/list]

Steam should now download this version of the game.

Just in case something goes awry!

notes.title: The Calendar-Contest - Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

A quick update on the calendar contest!

1. We are extending the deadline for submitting screenshots by two more days, so the contest will end on 8 June 2022 at 23:59 CET.

2. We have received some wonderful pictures, but the HUD is in the image. Here's a hint: You can turn off the HUD with the keyboard shortcut "H".

3. You can save uncompressed images on Steam. To do this, select the "Steam" tab in the Steam client, then "Settings", then "In game" and tick "Save uncompressed copy". For this copy you should choose a separate folder because the screenshot will be saved two times.

4. You are invited to submit smaller image formats than the desired 4k. It is primarily about the pixel density, the resolution is important, but not everything. If necessary, a screenshot can be scaled up to 300 dpi in an image editor for printing.

Otherwise, all remains the same [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1129580/announcements/detail/3218396837686504079]as before[/url]!

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty Calendar Contest
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been a while since we last held a [b]contest,[/b] hasn’t it?

Well, we have another one for you today.

What it is about, you ask?

Last year you absolutely floored us by sending us more than 1000 screenshots! Each category was filled to the brim with the most amazing images showing off the game, your creativity, and your personal experiences.

Since then, the game has changed considerably, offering many more opportunities for passionate screensnipers and dedicated decorators.

So, we thought, let’s collect screenshots once again and this time turn them into something extra special. Something to remember those experiences by, something to celebrate that creativity and something that everybody has use for. Our plan? For 2023 we will be making our own Medieval Dynasty calendar. A calendar featuring the best in-game impressions throughout the seasons!

The calendar will be available later this year in physical as well as in digital form.

What is in it for you? Fame! Your name and your screenshot will be irrevocably linked to the first official Medieval Dynasty calendar ever. Also, you’ll get a copy of Sengoku Dynasty (Steam key) once it is coming to Early Access. And of course, a physical copy of the calendar (if participating from the EU) or a file for print.

So how to participate?

Send us up to four screenshots, one screenshot for a single season or four with a full circle of seasons. Only your own works. Resolution (here begins the challenge): at least 300 ppi, that means a 4k or higher resolution. (300ppi with 426 x 303mm which means 5031 x 3579 Pixels).

The top and bottom of your screenshot should not contain anything important like eyecatchers etc.

Send the files via a filelink/filehoster and via e-mail to this address:

[b]community@toplitz-productions.com[/b]

[i]The closing date is June 6, 2022, 23:59 CET.[/i]

Any questions? Shoot below!

The small print is here:

[url=https://discord.com/channels/565138322679398440/565534156826738709/977151184748023818]Discord Link[/url]

Good luck!

PS: please feel absolutely free to post screenshots on our social media channels. Hope to see some there as well.

notes.title: The mysterious message gets revealed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have some good news to share with you! The scoundrels who took the notes from the village have been captured at the edge of the valley! They paid their fine, but let's turn our attention to the most important thing: the contents of the notes!

We break the seal!

We unroll the parchment.

Are you curious too?

We read the royal instructions.

They're hard to read.

Oops, the scroll was upside down.

Now, the right way round.

*Deep breath*

Co-op!

notes.title: A mysterious message!
notes.notes:
Hello village elders!
 
The King's Herald has delivered a new message to the valley. When he handed it over, he seemed pleased and delighted. There might be something important in it. But unfortunately, some sheets were stolen by bandits shortly afterwards and since then the news is mostly gone. The part they left behind we gladly share with you:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/5df9ddaaf3eb2175bd940e26bb2e1c1c5351e83e.jpg[/img]
 
Shame on the villains, but the hunters have swarmed out to recover the full notes. Now we must wait for their return.  It might take a few days. We hope you'll be patient?!

But feel free to ponder what might have gone missing. Post it here in the comments, or on the social media channels.

Here we go!

The Render Cube and Toplitz Productions teams

PS: We will host a chat with the team chat tonight (April 14th, 2022) from 7 pm - midnight CEST.

notes.title: The Eagle has landed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/21f7f690867ad1cd649a3ea20b7403972da1ac51.jpg[/img]


Hello village elders!

As you know, you live here in a peaceful valley far off from the hustle and bustle, and most of the time it's quiet out in the great wide open. Too quiet?

We went out and gathered a few animals to add to the background noise. We found quacking ducks, screeching sea eagles, hawks, and crows. Along with mysterious cooing pigeons, they will provide the soundtrack of the world with their tunes from now on.

[previewyoutube=vuAXfEhJzDQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of the fauna, too, will now be able to contribute more than before. Hunters, listen up: You may now decorate your cosy home with hunting trophies! If you're going to bring a big sixteen-pointer, then you should show it off in your living room!

Tell us what you love about the update. Tell us in the comments or drop us a line on our social media channels!

Good hunting!

The Render Cube and Toplitz Productions teams

PS: We will host a chat with the team chat tonight (April 14th, 2022) from 7 pm - midnight CEST.

Gather and behold the latest acquisition to the valley! A few resourceful heads from faraway places have stopped at the tavern and told the villagers about a machine that turns grain into flour by using the power of the wind.

notes.title: Third Person View – The first big Roadmap update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Since the 1.0 release of Medieval Dynasty this fall, we are now on the road of adding many more features and functions to the game. This first major update is a “quality-of-life” update in its purest form.

[previewyoutube=tY8yYrLF5IM;full][/previewyoutube]

When playing games in first person view, some of you may experience something called “simulator sickness”. Originally this subset of the motion sickness was discovered when training pilots. Scientists – after researching this sickness – found two plausible theories: a sensory conflict or a postural instability, a balance disorder. Whatever the reason behind, the effects are the same: vertigo, nausea, disorientation, or discomfort. To ensure that everyone can enjoy Medieval Dynasty to the best extent possible, we are now introducing the Third Person View as an optional feature. 

So, whether you are affected by any of the above symptoms or just like to roam around in the Medieval world from a different perspective, we hope you are enjoying this additional feature to the game!

In addition to Third Person Perspective, we have added a much-requested change that is sure to make your heart beat faster! From now on, you can change settings and adjust them during the game! Something that was previously only possible before the start of a new game. You need more power and storage space to transport things? One click and you can pick up as much as you want. You are facing an almost invincible fiend? Quickly increase health points, fight the enemy, and continue playing in a relaxed manner. Now with these new possibilities, you can transform old save games. For example, increase the number of buildings and further expand your city. What do you think? We are listening to your wishes!

See you around!

Here is the link to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1129580/discussions/1/4345408777041476970/]Update Notes[/url].

notes.title: Third Person View - Teaser
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re happy to make Medieval Dynasty accessible to an even broader audience soon! 

In first person view it may be disturbing not to see your own body, this can affect perception and cause unwanted efficiencies like nausea and dizziness. The dreaded motion sickness.

The Third Person View is countering this effect and helps those affected, so they can play games that would normally take their toll on well-being.

Check out the teaser video now:

[previewyoutube=b3eaY2df2tE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The 2021 Steam Award Nominations!
notes.notes:
Hello Folks!

Steam Awards are coming soon and now you can nominate Medieval Dynasty for an award. We’ve chosen the ‘Sit back and relax’ category for this game and we hope you agree. This is how you do it:

1. Launch Steam,
2. Vote for Medieval Dynasty as a candidate in the “Sit back and Relax” category,
3. Now get into a seated posture of your choice, 
4. Start Medieval Dynasty,
5. Go ZEN.

That’s all. You’re relaxed, right?
Best wishes and many thanks!

notes.title: Survive the Amazon and Survive the Middle Ages in This Special Bundle
notes.notes:
Hey Folks, 

We joined forces with @creepyjar to bring you the Survival Instincts Bundle.

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty Features Round-up Video
notes.notes:
Welcome Village Leaders,

Are you new around these parts and you’re wondering what Medieval Dynasty has to offer? Curious to see what kind of activities are there for you? If you are, watch our Medieval Dynasty Features Round-up Video and find out what you will have to do to survive in medieval times. 

[previewyoutube=ZWFHKfIKXgM;full][/previewyoutube]

As you see, there are a lot of things for you to do and take care of. No one said surviving in the Middle Ages was going to be easy. And remember - you are here to make a name for yourself. So make friends, find your wife, and start your own Dynasty!


Good luck Village Leader. May your name be known far and wide!

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty Now Supports Razer Chroma
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are proud to announce that Medieval Dynasty is now supporting Razer Chroma devices! Prepare yourself for a more immersive gaming experience together with Razer Chroma effects specially adapted to our game.

[previewyoutube=HhMPdfRNRns;full][/previewyoutube]

Wondering what your health, food, or water levels are? Don’t be, with a quick glance on your Razer keyboard you will see what their levels are just by looking at the lights under the keys. Keys will also represent your character’s quick slots, they will pulsate depending on the type of damage you will receive, and loads more of other effects.

All of these functions will make your sessions in Gostovia that more immersive!

You can see the full list of all game effects below.


Village Leaders, we’ll speak to you soon!

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams


[b]Game Effects:[/b]
[list]
[*] By default, all keys on the keyboard are highlighted with a mild white light.
[*] F1-F12 keys display the status of three parameters: health level (F1-F4), food level (F5-F8), and water level (F9-F12) - the lower the value, the fewer buttons are lit.
[*] Blink effects for health, food, and water bars - the lower the level, the higher the flashing frequency.
[*] 1-8 keys reflect the character's quickslots - grey lit (no item in the slot), yellow lit (the item is assigned to the slot, but is not currently equipped), green lit (the item is assigned to the slot and it’s currently in use).
[*] Keyboard effects for hit and fall damage - red pulsating effect.
[*] Keyboard effects for cold damage - red and white pulsating effect.
[*] Keyboard effects for hunger damage - red and orange pulsating effect.
[*] Keyboard effects for thirst damage - red and blue pulsating effect.
[*] Keyboard effects for injuries caused by poisoning - red, purple, and green pulsating effect.
[/list]

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty review
notes.notes: Having put the finishing touches on the fourth building in my little village-to-be, I realise I need to go out hunting to get more food for the few denizens that dwell within it. It's my job to look after them, after all, and that means building shelter and services, but also going out to hunt some bison or deer for meat. I feel pretty confident as I head out… but end up dying to a boar taking a bite out of my ankle... Read more.

notes.title: Today's last notice on the virtual desk. A roadmap.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We hope you enjoy playing our game right now?! Very good! 

Since the game started in the Early Access everything that was planned and even things that were not planned (thank you, dear community) found their way into Medieval Dynasty. So far, so good.
We bring you some news. These news will be quick and painless. Here is the roadmap for the things beyond the scope, the things you did not expect, the surprise! 😉

We know that a lot of people suffer from motion sickness and 1st person view settings do not always ease it. Thus, we plan to add Third Person View to lift off the burden of the sickness and have the players enjoy the game from a different angle (sorry, pun).

Next up is a wider array of decorations for housing or even the village. Only a cozy village is a place that is worth living in, so it needs more variety to create the coziness.

Some people mentioned the windmill in the last weeks, we’ll try to import this high-tech building into the game, along with a few more animal species you can adopt to your village or maybe hunt. We have some ideas there.

Next in line we have the heir which we will add more in-depth interaction with, likely special quests and more discussions. Maybe your son will be extremely investigative, who knows?!

Then we have something our console players might become very excited about: Medieval Dynasty is meeting a few consoles. Which ones? You’ll hear about it once we have arranged a date.

Last but not least: armors, crests and shields. And more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/06c068bb62bca5f7e1e3d39564b98f1bc972c752.jpg[/img]

You carried us this far from the start of the Early Access, till now, the Full Release. Now we will pick up the torch and carry the game even further from where we imagined it to be! Will you follow us? Is it time to get even more excited?!

As always, we’re eager to read some feedback from you. 

Your Render Cube and Toplitz teams

notes.title: Important Announcement - Early Access Saves on 1.0 Full Release Day
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

We have some important information regarding Medieval Dynasty 1.0 Full Release and your current save files. Some of you asked us what will happen with the game saves from the Early Access version of the game once Medieval Dynasty enters the 1.0 state. Well, the answer is a bit complicated, so sit back, grab a cup of tea or coffee, and read through all the info that you need to know.

Since we are adding new storylines, fixes, new characters, changes to the map, and more to Medieval Dynasty, your current saves may not function properly from Early Access to the 1.0 version. However, we have three options/workarounds that you might want to take a look at before the full release occurs.

[b]Option 1: [/b]

Download the 1.0 Full Release update and enjoy your new medieval experience from the beginning. However, this time around you will be able to take part in a new and extended storyline. On your way to creating a successful dynasty, you will meet new people, get access to all new additions and features that will come along with the 1.0 release, experience exciting twists, and go on new quests. It’s experiencing Medieval Dynasty in all its glory.


[b]Option 2:[/b]

This option is for all Village Leaders who don’t want to start from scratch. For all of you who wish to continue your villages as they are, we will create a separate game branch on Steam so that you can enjoy and grow your already built dynasties. You will not lose your saves and you can continue to develop your villages exactly as before. This branch will support Medieval Dynasty version 0.6.0.5. Keep in mind though, if you choose this option, you will miss out on the new content that will be added with the 1.0 Full Release. If this is not a dealbreaker for you, this might be an option for you. 

[b]Option 3:[/b]

If you don’t want to miss out on your previous work and you want to enjoy new content, this workaround might be for you. You can load your Early Access save file with Medieval Dynasty’s 1.0 version. If you do that, most of the new content should work properly. However, some problems may occur. Due to changes to the map and environment, you may find your village is floating in the air or be stuck in the ground or under water. You may also find problems with quest givers, npcs, and other characters. In rare cases, you might find a bandit’s camp in your village. Keep in mind though that with this workaround, the new storyline and quests will not be available. If this is something you don't mind and you are ok with possible errors and mistakes, then this option is for you.

[b]Please note that you can copy/store saves in a different portion of your hard drive, so they’re safe, just in case something goes awry with the original save game! [/b]

We know how much time you invested in this game and how much effort you put into your villages. And we know that these workarounds may not be 100% what you were looking for, but we feel that a new, improved storyline with more quests and characters is worth the effort. We also tested out and tried to find as many solutions for you as well, so we hope that some of these workarounds are an option that you’ll be happy with and let you continue your medieval journey. 

If you have any questions, write to us in the comment section below. We are here for you. And we can't wait for you to see Medieval Dynasty in it’s full version. We’re as excited for it as you are.


Until next time,

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: A quick glance of what’s coming soon to Medieval Dynasty
notes.notes:
Welcome Village Leaders,

Now that the Medieval Dynasty 1.0 Release Date has been announced (September 23rd, for those that missed it!), it’s time we tease you a bit with what’s coming to the game. Today we’ll reveal a few of the upcoming new features and additions that are coming to Medieval Dynasty. So, let us reveal some sweet medieval gossip!

As you might already know, soon on your travels you’ll encounter the not so friendly bandits. These individuals will set up their camps all over the lands. Where exactly, you might ask? Well, it is hard to tell since their locations do change over time. So be careful as you travel and wonder because you never know when and where these outlaws may lurk!

Another upcoming addition to the game will be herbalism. Soon you’ll be able to create many potions and elixirs that have different uses and effects. To create these mixtures and concoctions, you have to collect specific herbs. We will also add new plants and herbs as well to give you a bit of variety. Find them, collect them, and prepare drinks that will boost your stats - and even give you night vision! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/0cf6349eb402751cc2212bd1c33c3bc5a8485417.png[/img]

[i]I wonder what he is making there...[/i]

And finally, Leaders, there are new buildings coming to your village as well! Now, we don’t want to spoil all the fun in one post, so what we will do is show some screens of the new buildings, but we won't say what their purpose is. What are these buildings and what are they used for? Well, we’ll leave that as a mystery for now...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/5c0acd122c327a717b4cc4d71aa95d2c39cc12c4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/95e2e58090a3d542b2b584f7196bdceb1c7157ef.png[/img]

So, tell us, what do you think about some of those upcoming features? And what do you think those buildings provide? We are curious to see if you can guess. Go on, don’t be shy. Let us know your thoughts and answers in the comment section below!

Until next time,

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date and New Price Announced
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have some [b]huge news[/b] for you. Our work on Medieval Dynasty Early Access version is slowly coming to its end, and the 1.0 release is in sight. It’s been nearly one year since we started this journey with you. A time full of work, creativity, testing, and working together with you. It was feverish at times, but all of that sweat and sleepless nights were definitely worth it. Now we are proud to announce the big date. Grab your pencils Medieval Dynasty 1.0 will be released on [b]23rd of September 2021[/b].

With the Medieval Dynasty 1.0 Full Release we are planning to give you more content, upgrades, and balances to the game (right now, we can give you two words as a tease: bandits and herbalism. Intrigued? We don’t blame you...). We will give you more info about what’s coming soon. But our work will not stop there. Once Medieval Dynasty 1.0 is released, we will publish a new Road Map with post release content and support that you can expect to be added. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/432bed07355ad404f7d0d89ed141630b0abed67f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/931e0f210204d3014d531b1e55ccc87adc0afa5b.jpg[/img]

Today we also want to give you important info and heads up about Medieval Dynasty’s price. Since the 1.0 Full Release is getting closer and closer, and with that our game will contain more content and polish, we will increase the price of the game to EUR 29.99 | USD 34,99 | GBP 27,99 | CNY 189 as of the 15th of August 2021. We are writing about this price increase right now because we want to give any potential new players a heads up, just in case they would like to buy the game at a lower price.

And if the current price is still too much for you, don’t fret! As of now, we are starting our very last Steam sale before Medieval Dynasty 1.0 Full Release. So take advantage of this unique opportunity and grab the game at the pre-release price together with a 20% discount! Don’t wait too long though as this sale ends on 9th of August. 

We’re really looking forward to finally bringing the 1.0 version to you all soon! Can’t wait to share with you what we have in store. Stay tuned, as news about that in the coming weeks. 


Until next time,

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #5!
notes.notes:
Welcome Village Leaders,

Our 5th Medieval Dynasty Roadmap Update is ready for you to download! But before you return to your village, have a read on the latest additions that just came to the game. 

[previewyoutube=QHwbwyWum8E;full][/previewyoutube]

First new addition - relationships. There is nothing better in life than a happy and strong marriage. Unfortunately, to get there, there is a winding and bumpy road to cross called flirting. From now on, you have more verbal opportunities at your disposal to win the heart of your chosen one. A compliment, a joke, a fun fact, a gossip, or the good old power of poetry - use them all to attract the attention of your lady. To strengthen your chances a little, you can also give your chosen one something special, a gift that will steal her heart you might say. As you gain experience, more options will be available to you in the art of flirting. So don’t wait, go out and meet some people! There’s someone out there for everyone.

If you are looking for that special gift, the exotic goods Vendors are the people with those unique and precious items which you can use as presents. Stay alert, as they will appear in random taverns at different seasons.

Next up are Shops and Vendors. You can now set up your own Market Stall and sell goods of your choice. And if you are in need to be somewhere else, don’t worry, all you have to do is assign a villager, he or she will take care of your place, and the business keeps going.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/5b9d3bb4240e818c09044b979f43a935063aec01.jpg[/img]

[i]Set up a Market Stall and earn that extra money.[/i]

Also with this update we’ve added a new animal which lives in the forest - the lynx. Watch out though as this isn't a nice kitty that you want to hang out with. He is wild and dangerous. But don’t worry, we’ve got your back. With a brand-new wooden crossbow at your disposal, you don’t have to be worried too much about it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/02768c06a708a62cd637bab1c171b03ff70ce2a0.jpg[/img]

Lynx - a little kitten that can cause a lot of trouble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/7c37216f8b9a749bd649436c7dab10d0e005f8d2.jpg[/img]

Wooden crossbow - a new weapon for your arsenal. 

We don't want to keep you away from your settlement, so go and enjoy the new additions! We, on the other hand, will be watching the comments to see what your thoughts are.

If you want to find out all the details about this update, read the changelog below. And don’t forget to share your thoughts!


Until next time,

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams
