notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - A Glimpse of Upcoming Features and Additions
notes.notes:
Welcome Village Leaders,

For the last few months, we’ve been tucked away working on Medieval Dynasty and making the game better, more optimized, and with new content. Correcting errors, squashing bugs, optimizing, they’re all-important parts of the Early Access phase. Deep inside though, we know it’s the new additions to the game that you are most looking forward to! So, let’s not keep you waiting and let us show you what we'll be adding to the game in an upcoming update!

First up, let’s talk about the important thing in life. No, it’s not a large village, kilos of gold, or a donkey (although that donkey does come close). We’re talking here about love. It’s hard to imagine building a dynasty without a significant other. But you have to bring your flirting a-game to conquer hearts in the Middle Ages. Winning the heart of your chosen future bride is not an easy task. Many brave men have fallen in this intricate battle of words and gestures. In Medieval Dynasty flirting will soon be more elaborate. 

In the next update, we will add four types of personalities to NPCs. The correct recognition of their personality will allow you to choose better flirting options, and at the same time, it will lower the chance of a negative reaction. [b]Flirting[/b] is a complicated art form that will soon be available to you. You will find a few new interactions to use: a compliment, a joke, a fun fact, a gossip, or you can use the power of poetry to attract your lady. As you gain more experience in this field, a higher Affection level will be unlocked, giving you more romantic options to use. 

If you feel that your words are not enough to win the heart of your chosen one, you can also improve your chances of romance by giving her a gift. Just remember that you can only give one gift per season. And not everyone will like the same presents, so gift wisely. You will find these gifts at [b]special vendors [/b]that will appear in random neighbour taverns in different seasons. 
Once you are successful and your chosen lady finally becomes your wife, new opportunities will arise. However, we will leave that for you to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/7037a710c7fdd832ff66977a2f5347aa9b31a2d3.jpg[/img]
[i]Flirting - a delicate battle for the heart of the chosen one.[/i]

[b]Shops and Vendors[/b] are one of the new features that will be added with the next update. Soon you will be able to set up your own stalls and you will decide what to sell in them. There are many available options for you: baked goods, clothes, tools, weapons, and many more. All you have to do is build a shop and assign a resident to be the shopkeeper. This is a great way to make more money. Assign a villager, sell your goods, and while people are buying your goods, you can do something more useful (or not - you’re the boss).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/fc47dd70575517ec6c12b1aeb6c4b26dfdf74cf1.jpg[/img]

[i]Your own shop - here with resources…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/4bc8c27452c6556a0c628452a11cb33e7efa2892.jpg[/img]

[i]… and here weapons and tools. [/i]

And very quickly, expect some new animals in the wild (was that a lynx that just ran past!?!) and a wooden crossbow. But we will tell you more about this the next time we meet. 

That’s it from us! It was supposed to be a short glimpse after all, but it turned into a bit of a full-blown peek! Let us know what you think of these new features in the comments below. And as always, follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and our Discord channels (who knows what goodies are hiding in those channels!). Stay tuned - we will reveal even more info soon.


Until next time,

Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty took 3rd Place at Digital Dragons Indie Celebration Competition
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This weekend Digital Dragons Indie Celebration Competition 2021 has finished up. And we have some big news. We are very proud to announce that[b] Medieval Dynasty received the 3rd Place Award at the show![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/351c78996166833f3fba6df1cfa32fb7b7f348ca.png[/img]

We are very happy and proud that we got nominated, and to come away with 3rd place prize is a cherry on the proverbial cake (it’s nice to add this win to our last month’s Dreamhack nomination)! 

We want to thank Digital Dragons for the nomination and award. They do a great job in developing the gamedev scene and contribute greatly to the promotion of indie developers. This is a hugely important mission and you are carrying it out brilliantly!

We also want to thank everyone who took some time and voted for us. Thank you for your support and faith. It means that our work is worth our time and commitment. Thanks to you, we are catching the wind in our wings for further actions. And because of your constant feedback and support, you’re making Medieval Dynasty better. So once again, thank you for your support.

Ladies and Gentlemen, one last time: Medieval Dynasty won the 3rd Place Award!!!


Until next time,

Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #4!
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

The time has come! The update is here! Here is the next Medieval Dynasty Roadmap Major Update. This time, we’ve added new resources, new tools and activities, a hairy new companion, and a whole lot of fixes and optimizations. Let’s take a look at all the additions in more detail.

It’s hard to imagine the growth of a community without proper resources. From now on in addition to iron, now you can also dig copper and tin. You will find copper and tin in caves, and these deposits are easy to reach. To find iron though, you have to dig a little bit deeper, into the caves themselves. To get access to their depths, you will need to build mines. Down below is the home to the valuable iron ore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/302acf9300697af4448040acb798b94c33e16f3d.jpg[/img]
[i]Just a few more hits, and we’ll be there.[/i]

After collecting those precious ores, you, or your people, can take them back to your village smithy. The blacksmith will smelt the raw tin and copper ores into tin and copper bars, which you can then combine and create the coveted bronze bars. Iron is a simpler process - you can convert iron ores straight into iron bars. Use these valuable bars to create a whole new range of copper and bronze tools and weapons, such as hammers, sickles, knives, bolts, arrows and more. 

As you can see there is a whole new underground world with hidden treasures waiting to be discovered by you.

We also added a new model of transportation - a donkey. He is slower than your old friend, the trusty horse, but he can carry more stuff than his bigger cousin. And he’s also cheaper. The perfect value-for-money companion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/a1c8786e00d1f65a342bc111ac634398e44c63e8.jpg[/img]
[i]Your new steed, sire![/i]

But that’s not all that you will get in this update. Take some time off from your everyday tasks, venture out, and visit Tutki. This is the place you can find and buy a donkey. We have also added a whole lot of fixes and other updates too. One of them is a change in buying and selling prices. From now on all selling prices will be higher and buying prices will be lower. See the changelog for all the details. And one last thing! From now on all our Dutch, Chinese, and Swedish fans can enjoy their medieval experience in their own languages.

Let us know what you think about this Major update below. Write down your thoughts in the comments section. What is the first thing you will do in the new update? We’re curious to hear your answers. And as always, don’t be shy, stay in touch, and follow us on our Social Media Channels.


All the best,

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #3!
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

With calendar spring now in its second week, it is a bit symbolic that our 3rd major Medieval Dynasty Update arrives at around the same time. This update brings a lot of new features, mechanics, updates, fixes, and heaps more. But let us start with what a lot of you have been waiting for. New building types, professions, and products.

[previewyoutube=8eMQ5-rWmU0;full][/previewyoutube]

First up, alcohol. In the middle ages, alcohol was a highly valued commodity. Not only did it provide “entertainment” to the people, but it was also treated as a medicine. In some places, access to clean water was not an option. So, what do you do when you are thirsty? Well, have a quick gulp of some beer or wine of course! With that short history lesson out of the way, here is our first new feature - the ability to produce alcohol. You now have access to a new type of field, the Orchards, and you can plant new trees and plants, such as apple trees, cherries, plums, hops, and more. And once the plants come bearing fruit, you will be able to pick them, and with the newly added Brewing Station and Wine Barrels, turn them into beer, wine, ciders and even juices (variety is the spice of life as they say). You can of course keep the alcohol for yourself and your people or turn it into profit. That decision is all up to you - just do not drink it all yourself as the consequences will be a bit hazy and painful.  

Next up, we have beekeeping. This is a feature that a few of us in the office have been excited the most about simply because we adore those little buzzing creatures. You will now be able to build Apiaries in your village, a dedicated place for your beehives and your honeybees. You will be able to produce honey, which can be collected by your beekeepers, a highly valuable commodity which will help you create honeycomb and mead - the nectar of gods. This building will certainly get you buzzing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/20e1ed4776c4fb3e2128d780bfe23aa544e0eed2.jpg[/img]
[i]Collecting that sweet nectar.
[/i]
Another new building that we have added is the Workshop. Inside this building, you’ll be able to place workbenches where you or other skilled craftsmen can make, create, and operate the above-mentioned Brewing Stations, Wine Barrels, as well as manufacture clay pots and bottles using the Pottery Wheel, and make non-alcoholic juice using the Juice Press. This building is your non-stop shop for all those essential needs to make your medieval community thrive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/34827f75bd3a505dff830d384321b6199436184d.jpg[/img]
[i]Crafting in progress.[/i]

Another noticeable addition is new food that is available to you and your people, such as different types of porridges, tarts, rolls, eggs, and soups. We have also added eight new talents (for Farming, Extraction, Survival, Hunting, and Diplomacy), new animations, and we’ve increased the building limit too. Plus, lots and lots more.

And as always, let us know your thoughts, suggestions, ideas, and anything else either on our social channels or on our Discord server. And come by the r/MedievalDynasty Community on Reddit too. They are a friendly bunch of people (hello!!).

All the best

Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty Community Screenshot Contest!
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

With Medieval Dynasty now in its six month of Early Access, we thought it would be nice to give our Steam storefront a bit of a makeover. We wanted to refresh our Steam Store’s game screenshots, but seeing the screens that you, our community, have made, we had an idea. Perhaps you would like to take some official screenshots instead? And by doing so, win some prizes, gain glory, and be immortalised in Medieval Dynasty’s in-game credits! 

So with that in mind, we are starting our official Medieval Dynasty Community Screenshot Contest! The three best screenshots, according to our judges, will win one of three Amazon vouchers (1st place - 50 Euros, 2nd Place - 25 Euros, 3rd Place - 10 Euros). The ten best overall screenshots will have a chance to get on the Medieval Dynasty Steam and GOG and Epic storepages, and your name will be listed in Medieval Dynasty’s credits.

The contest starts today and will last till the 8th of March 2021 (midnight CET).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/c3f43ed4275def2bce1624aee7218fea8fbb1738.png[/img]

To take part, send us your screenshots which show one of following topics/themes:
[list]
[*] Building,
[*] Riding,
[*] Social Life,
[*] Hunting/Wildlife,
[*] Work,
[*] World/Environment,
[*] Animals in the village.
[/list]

The screenshots should be without HUD (press the “H” key to toggle the HUD) and in 4K resolution if possible, but HD is the minimum requirement. Once you are happy with what you have, email your or send a file link (use wetransfer for example) work to community*AT* toplitz-productions.com. You can send us as many screenshots as you like, however the maximum file size should not exceed 32 MB, in this case a file link becomes mandatory. Please use the lemma [b]"Medieval Dynasty screenshot contest"[/b] in the email subject, contrary subject titles are not taken into consideration.
 
If you feel the need to express your inner medieval photographer then throw your hat in the ring! We will announce the winners on our Social Media channels and on Steam shortly after the contest ends.
 
 
Take care and good luck!
 
Your Toplitz Team
 
[i]Contest rules:
[list]
[*] Sending in one or more screenshots serves as acceptance of terms and services for this contest.
[*] There are no alternatives to these prizes. They are as stated and are non-transferable. The winner will be contacted via direct message/e-mail. 
[*] Any entry, which does not comply with the rules, may be deemed invalid at the sole discretion of TOPLITZ. 
[*] In order to participate participants must provide certain information on themselves. This personal information is collected and processed only for the purposes of organising, running and monitoring the campaign, as well as for carrying out publicity activities on it. The organising entity shall be considered the data controller for the database containing this personal information and provides for an appropriate data protection level.
[*] Accepting files under reserve, especially if files exceed size limit.
[*] Winners are subjectively selected by a Toplitz jury.
[*] Only one file entrance per user but any number of screenshots, please use file link if the file exceeds the mentioned file size.
[*] Property of creator. You made this screenshot.
[*] Local regulations for the participation in contests apply.
[*] All rights for the usage of all entrances are transferred to Toplitz Production without compensation and can be used on- and offline.
[*] Winners may be mentioned with their names or aliases (if requested).
[*] All decisions are final.
[/list]

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Balance Pass and Lots More
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

What better way to start the new month than by uploading a new update. This time, we put our effort into rebalancing the game, and we also added a few extra new features too. So take a closer look to find out what you will get right after the download ends. 

First up, we rebalanced the game’s economy. We’ve gathered some of your feedback about the prices, item requirements for crafting, etc, and we worked on the numbers. You can expect that item prices, weights, food and water values, amount of items needed to craft recipes, crafting times, production times, damage and costs of tools are now better balanced. No more higher prices for a stick and rock compared to the whole hammer.

The other main addition in this update is the Henhouse upgrade - a redesigned building for your village. This building will allow you to collect eggs and feathers from your flock. The upgrade for the building is now available. Take a look at it now!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/715771349f487496d0b652705d112e67e454cb05.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/387ff01b8bc6b93eb583075704b41b976583b9d3.jpg[/img]
[i]The Henhouse.[/i]

It ‘s good to have a home while it’s cold outside.

Speaking of animals, there are now roosters and ganders. We’ve also added animal feed, meaning that if you want them to produce milk, eggs etc. they need to get food. New feed racks will show you the status of your animal hunger. 

There’s also lots of fixes big and small. Please check the changelog below.

As always let us know what you think about this update in the comment section. What do you think, what you like the most, what else would you like to see in the future in the Medieval Dynasty? Let us know.


Until next time.

Your Toplitz and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #2!
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

Say hello to our second Medieval Dynasty Major Update. This time you will get brand new features, new buildings, and changes to the mechanics of the game. So, let us get to know all of these additions a little better.

Let us start with your new companion - the horse. This trusty fellow will get you on his back, wherever you wish to. Not only will you get to your destination point with your best friend, but also you will get there faster. Isn’t that convenient? Your horse is equipped with a special backpack with which you can carry more staff to trade and sell. But do not forget about your horse’s needs. He needs some rest and good food after a hard day's work. You can take care of him at the new building - the stable. So make sure you will get one, before you get your new four-legged friend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/f6de5525aaaaa0ca032b0d5b3d2ea891eaea9cc8.jpg[/img]
[i]The Stable - home for your horse companion.[/i]

Our next addition is all about the farming animals. From now on your animals can reproduce. Keep them happy, in good shape, and they will pay you off with a precious little baby. Just imagine how much your farms can grow. Not to mention that it is a great way to save your hard-earned money.

Also on the menu: challenges! Spice up your town life by accepting a challenge here and there!

Finally - building limits. Thanks to a lot of optimization work, we can push our 30-building limit to a new level. With this update you can place up to 40 buildings in your village. Your settlement can be bigger than ever before. 

These are just some of the features that you will get with this second Medieval Dynasty Major Update. To find out all the details, read our changelog below.


Until next time.

Your Toplitz and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - A tease of things to come part 2
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders, 

We want to waive some of the mystery about what’s coming in the next Medieval Dynasty update. We are excited to see how our game develops every day, and it’s pretty tempting to share with you what we are currently working on. So here it is - a tease of what’s ahead. 

Many of you have asked for the ability to build paths and roads in Medieval Dynasty. Well, as of next update, your wishes will be granted. You can plan the layout of buildings and roads according to your plan. 

But this is not all that we have prepared for you. For those who are a bit bored with hunting wild animals in the forest, now there is an additional opportunity to get food - fishing. You’ll be able to catch different species of fish in various locations and craft new tools. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/4c60f6da600d3b0b71f0c0fc2b7e080583ad88d1.jpg[/img]

This update will be coming soon. It’ll first arrive on the public TEST branch, and once it is confirmed that it all works, and be added to the main game. Stay tuned and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and Discord for all the info that you need and want to hear.  

Stay safe and until next time. 

Your Toplitz and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Q&A - Part 4
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leaders,

Grab a chair and enjoy our fourth episode of Q&A with Medieval Dynasty Developers. notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #1!
notes.notes:
Hello Tribe Leaders, 

The day has finally come and the moment is finally here. The first big Medieval Dynasty’s content drop has arrived! So let’s get straight into what you are getting.

One of the major new additions are Events. As we explained in our last week’s teaser update, they are an extra layer to the gameplay. You will be faced with many scenarios that can play out depending on how you deal with them. One day, you might have to deal with heavy rains that damaged your crops, while a few months later your people might get a significant boost because the joy of Spring can be felt in the air. These events can have a major impact on your game and will test your wits and leadership tact. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/16db18555570178fff68e778d2ee2cb0930c52a8.png[/img]

[i]Tough decisions are ahead of you...[/i]

Events are not all that you will find in this update. As many of you requested we added some decorative items to the game. You can finally bring light to your quaint village by creating torches and lanterns. Not only will they provide light, but they’ll also add a bit of warmth too in those cold winter nights. We’ve also added furniture, so your people can have a place to sit and eat by, and we’ve added other little decorative items as well. All of this so that you can add your personal touch to your village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/51aa98dd2b9813bdd247d883681d280f8f86f866.jpg[/img]

[i]Lanterns will brighten up your nights.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/aa63a330fd29ce233b35f39632f6fa1c6e0566af.jpg[/img]

[i]Some new furniture for your tribe.[/i]

We’ve also made your life a little bit easier too. Now you can carry a lot more on you and your shoulders thanks to the new pouches and bags. They will help you with all the heavy lifting and make your trips to other villages more efficient and lucrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/74d1890e39986277cbc441ed5d53bc55333d1b71.jpg[/img]

[i]Your new bag collection[/i]

We’ve also heard your requests to have customizable gameplay options. You can now play around and adjust such setting as the number of days per season, the tax multiplier, give yourself unlimited health, food, water, and more. A lot of you wanted to be able to play around with these options and play the game you wanted – we hope this is exactly what you were looking for.

These are just some of the major changes that we brought into the Medieval Dynasty world. For a full list, take a look at our changelog below. Let us know what you think of these new additions too. And as always, follow us on Facebook and Twitter for all the latest updates (and a big shout out to our r/MedievalDynasty Reddit community!). Remember, this update is just the beginning. 


Until next time. 

Your Toplitz and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: A tease of the upcoming content drop
notes.notes:
Hello Tribe Leaders, 

First, we must get one thing out of the way. The reception that we got from you has been HUGE! We are a month after release, and we are still receiving great feedback from you every day. We never imagined that you would take such a shining to our game, so once again, thank you for all your support.

Now, let us get into the good stuff! Here is a little tease of what is coming in the first major Medieval Dynasty content drop.

One of the first big additions to the game are Events. The events will cover various aspects of gameplay, and depending on your decisions, they will have specific outcomes. To give you an idea of how they work, here is an example. You have heard rumours of over 20 wolves being within the vicinity of the village. How will you react to this news? Will you tell the village not to worry about it, or will you go out and take care of the wolves yourself, or perhaps something in between? And how will your decision impact the village itself? These events will not only give you a bit more variety, but they will also test your leadership skills too. Remember, your decisions can have consequences.

We are also adding a few more items for you that will make your life easier, and your village prettier. We do not want to spoil everything here, but to all of you that wanted some street lighting, take a look at the image below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/a36d0ca2350f9a978fd8d93e20adc94265a0c685.jpg[/img]

There’s a lot more that’s coming to Medieval Dynasty really soon, but spoiling it all now would ruin the surprise later - so we’ll just leave it at this and let you speculate until the content drop arrives (yes, we can be cruel like that as well). Overall, though, we hope that you’ll be quite happy with what we have in store.

Until then, take care of yourself, and we’ll speak soon!

Regards, 
Your Toplitz and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Cloud Saving is coming to Medieval Dynasty
notes.notes:
Hello Tribe Leaders, 

A quick, but important update from us. As of this very moment, Medieval Dynasty supports Cloud saving, meaning that you can take your medieval lifestyle to any PC you please and not worry that you’ll lose your progress in case something happens to your drive. Local saves will still be present, but now they will sync with the cloud as well. 

We will have more Medieval Dynasty news coming up really (like, really, really) soon. Watch this space!


Regards

Your Toplitz and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Language Update
notes.notes:

We’ve now added new languages to the game! From now on, you can enjoy your medieval adventure in Russian, Ukrainian, Italian, French, Czech, Turkish, Japanese, Portuguese, and Brazilian Portuguese languages. 

And if your language is not on the list, don’t worry. We are also working on adding: Swedish, Dutch, and Simplified Chinese. We will let you know when these languages will be added, so stay tuned to our Social Media channels.

Stay safe,

Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Team

notes.title: A big thank you!
notes.notes:
Tribe Leaders, 

It’s been a week since Medieval Dynasty came out, and to say that it’s been thrilling is an understatement. It’s been absolutely insane. Our release has gone way above our expectations. To get over 1.5 thousand reviews with 90% of them positive in the first 3 days was incredible, humbling and just… really nice to see. It kept us going through the weekend, giving us power to push when we were working on hotfixes ːsteamhappyː

We will be keeping you informed on developments as well, so you know what we are doing and planning to do.

notes.title: A Bit on Main Quests, Side Quests, and Chapters in Medieval Dynasty
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leaders,

Today we want to tell you a bit more about main quests, side quests, and chapters in Medieval Dynasty. Apart from surviving, growing your tribe and building your city, you will also experience a story and you will come across quests from people that are in need. There will be three types of categories of quests that you will experience: main quests, side quests, and chapters. Here is a little breakdown of those three.

Main quests are the big story lines in Medieval Dynasty. They will take place all over the world, with some spanning over decades of in-game time. There will be dozens of hours of quest gameplay in the Early Access phase with more added as the game evolves. These will be long quests with huge rewards and they will be the backbone of the Medieval Dynasty story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/a4ffada61ecba3a98e062fa6f8ad0413295bf4f0.png[/img]

Apart from the big story quests, you also will have optional Side quests as well. They are smaller adventures that are scattered all over the world, which still pack a bit of punch. And although they might not be as time consuming as the main quests, they can provide a little fun on the side - and some nice rewards as well. They might be just the distraction that you are looking for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/d89023462182d48acdfda8d7e63e9fbac5eac0fc.png[/img]

And finally, you will also have Chapters in Medieval Dynasty. These aren’t story based quests per se. These are macro world conditions that you need to satisfy in order to unlock the next Chapters. Completing each Chapter will give you new skills, abilities and unlock new buildings that you can construct, so completing these Chapters is crucial for progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/9823d36a096d56bc9975ff94a0e97e505209a2f4.png[/img]

Obviously as the game will develop during Early Access, we will bring you more and more content to enjoy. Also we would love to hear your feedback so you can help us shape Medieval Dynasty along with us. And as always, let us know your thoughts below and follow us on our social media channels (you can find them down below). 

Stay safe and until next time,

Toplitz Team

notes.title: Production Update - Dependencies of the seasons and your environment - July 2020
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leader,

With a new month upon us, it’s time that we take a step back, and take you behind the production curtain in our latest Medieval Dynasty Production Update. This time we want to show you more about the survival aspect of this game, specifically on how the seasons will impact you, your tribe, and the world around. We will share some tips which will help you plan your actions, as the more you know, the better the chance that you and your tribe will survive. 

Let’s start with dependencies of the seasons. Each of the four seasons of the year has their own unique conditions which impact on you and your work. This is really important if you want to start cultivation. Before you start farming you have to remember that not only each plant has to be seeded at the right time of the year - you can only harvest it at the right time of the year too. Pretty much, we can’t sow in the wrong season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/a5c291a8bacedfe54ffecc5f3c0201a7931b5870.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/60fc0606e037f757c758ba87d3ed8fa5972462cc.jpg[/img]

[i]Fields with people working on it.[/i]

Winter is governed by its own laws. Because of the low temperatures, it is impossible to cultivate the land. Therefore, you have to gather enough food to survive this difficult time. You also have to remember that for your people to survive, food will need to be stored in a special food storage building. So make sure that you plan your food supply chain well. If you don’t, you’re opening yourself up for a disaster.

Another important element you should pay special attention to are animals. There are 14 different types of wild and farm animals in the game. They are not only an additional source of food, but their fur also makes for great clothing, which will be definitely a good barrier against low temperatures. Farm animals can be expensive, but they are with no doubt worth their investment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/9b42290b50d3582dd76e2c07f965adf130355e4e.jpg[/img]

[i]One of the Medieval Dynasty farm animals - the cow.[/i]


So, as you can see, you have to keep your eyes open all the time to reach and use all the opportunities which will help you survive in this raw and harsh land. 

And finally, we have some new shots of the world itself. Take a look at the land which will be your new home in the not so distant future. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/2f94adfe12dbc30f80b73f77b1480b10f6562f33.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ad51882efd46f6910aff38e96f616eac19c357fc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/1269cd79173068292241af82a08fd911673d8e71.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/05f79b3a6a05f29726de00e54ada93e62555b68f.jpg[/img]

[I]Some of the environments in the Medieval Dynasty.[/i]


We hope that you’re enjoying the updates that we are sharing with you, and as always, write all your thoughts and questions in the comment section below. We love hearing your feedback and suggestions. And if there’s anything that you would like us to talk about specifically, write it down below!


Stay vigilant and until next time,

Toplitz Team

notes.title: Production Update - Animals, Plants and Clothes - June 2020
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leader,

It’s time for our next Medieval Dynasty Production Update. Today, we want to show you some of the things that we worked on recently over the last month. We also have some screenshots and images to go along with the update too, which we think will interest you the most. But let’s not prolong any further - let’s get into it!

Let’s start with some visual aspects of the game. Recently we added a variety of different versions of farm animals. There will be male, female, and baby animals. So far, we have sheep, goats, and pigs, but we are planning other farm animals too. And as a side note, there is nothing cuter than baby animals ;). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/682b4b1de2e3d153ff4adef6132eac9d41284b9a.png[/img]

[i]Versions of farm animals.[/i]


Now that we have animals covered, let’s move onto people. As you can see from the above image, our humble man needed some clothing. Not only to be appropriate but also so he won’t freeze during winter. Recently, we spent some time on creating new clothes for our medieval people. Before we started the process, we spent many hours researching historical sources and try to understand what type of clothing people wore in those days. After all, we want our game to be as authentic as possible. After collecting a large number of historical references, we were able to get down to work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/345feef105772e4ac73b6ff1bea72cc8760623d1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/09fa671b2eb2c56598fcd0f6d7405218c5ada719.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/1ba3c8ea7f3c11e8d0791e106f3567ac8d455eb5.png[/img]


[i]A small sample of the different clothes you will see in Medieval Dynasty.[/i]


While remaining on the subject of visuals, we can mention the changes we have made to the environment itself. We added more environment models, such as bushes and crops. We have created a variety of plant types that are specific to the environment too. We will have specific plants that are present in wetlands, mountain areas, forests, and meadows. We also made sure that they can change during the seasons as well. We also created various types of crops too - take a look at some of them below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/0fb54c15eddc227c0dd72520382db2c4b782e9f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/d2fa9c649ec4cbf3bd5d283b3118055de431b37d.png[/img]


[i]Some of the environments with their characteristic plants.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/36aee081bd618966235a351e988ccb0e91fa2a5b.png[/img]

[i]Different kinds of crops.[/i]


These are just some of the things we worked on recently. We also worked on some quests, buildings, vendors, and more. We hope you enjoyed this update and it gave you a bit more information on Medieval Dynasty is all about. And as always, send us your thoughts and questions in the comment section below. 

Stay safe and until next time,

Toplitz Team

notes.title: Production Update - Aging process, buildings and survival
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leader,

Every day, our game is taking shape and it’s becoming a bit more complete. Today, we wanted to share with you a few of the many things we've been working on over the last month or so. We hope you will find them interesting. So let's not prolong anymore. Let’s get to it.

One of the things we've been polishing are the looks of our characters. To give the feeling that your settlement is growing older and that time doesn’t stay still, we added an aging process to our characters. Not only will you see the aging process happen on character faces, but also their hair will change colour, getting greyer as time goes on. It’s a little detail that we think will make the game feel more realistic, and it’ll help you bond with the characters as well. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/26cff811079ecfcc4c13bef8b894622b387e9ac7.jpg[/img]

[i]Aging process in action. Same character, over a span of a lifetime. [/i]

While we’re on the topic of visuals, we took some time this month to refine the look of the buildings. They now have undergone a small renovation and have new foundations. And it’s not only the outside that changes. We've added new stairs as well, so you can access those higher-up places in style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/3a65db93487b4dee1ba4998f11f0a0c4dcbaac15.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/15795d55e2c2b5352c0c5d1fb40ad839a632a16a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/30d485e778c69f5360bf7be48d6e7a99dce01dd3.jpg[/img]

[i]Some of the buildings from your settlement. A Barn that needs fixing, a Hunting Lodge, and a House.[/i]

Finally, a little bit about our work on survival mechanics. We've added some elements to the game that we feel will make it more interesting. Life in the Middle Ages was not easy. There were many dangers waiting for people at every turn. The cold of winter was especially dangerous - you need to find a way to survive in harsh conditions. We've worked a lot on temperature mechanics and the role they play in the overall gameplay. And as silly as this little feature might sound, we worked on our campfires too! Fire will bring relief to frozen hands, but you have to be careful because if you get to close, it will hurt you. 

Apart from the mentioned topics above we have - as always - further improved and added overall gameplay elements, performance and stability.

We hope that this update gave you a bit of insight into what Medieval Dynasty is shaping up to be (of course, without revealing too much). By the way, if you want more info, videos, screenshots, and more, you can find it on our social channels. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Discord Server. 

Let us know what you thought of our update, and stay safe - not just in the game, but outside of it as well. We hope you’re well and healthy. 


Until next time,

Toplitz Team

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - New logo and artwork!
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leader,

Today's update is all about the new logo and artwork for Medieval Dynasty. Why the change? Well, we wanted the new designs to give a better “feel” for our game. Our artist wanted to create a logo that would show the idea of “dynasties”. If you look closer at the “V” symbol, you might notice that it’s made up of silhouettes of people standing behind each other. They could be your family, your group, your tribe. That relationship with others is shown in our artwork as well. It’s all about standing in unity - all for one, and one for all.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/5e3db2ebcf7816a258f636f879eecfb729119c05.jpg[/img]

About the game itself - there is still a lot of work ahead of us, but we will soon be sharing with you some more info. Really soon. And it goes without saying, thank you for all your support so far, including with all other projects that we have. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/409d857e3f69bff3eabff27c3f4b0df5a27d9417.png[/img]

[i]Image: Previous version of the Medieval Dynasty logo (Left), and the new logo of Medieval Dynasty (Right).[/i]

Let us know what you think of our new logo and artwork. Do you like them? Share your thoughts with us in the comment section below. And If you want to know more about this big project of ours, or just want to be in touch with us, follow us on our Facebook, Twitter, and Discord server. 

We are looking forward to the next time,

Toplitz Team
